tasks.prompt: Reproduce the main subject from the supplied photograph faithfully: keep the original pose, expression, gaze direction, proportions, clothing, accessories, visible lettering, object shapes and framing. Keep the same visible extent of the subject; do not invent limbs, people, products or a new scene. Remove incidental background people and distracting scenery. Use a clean white or very lightly indicated background so the main subject stands out. Do not reconstruct detail in blurred areas. Separate the subject clearly from the background with precise contours. Render a realistic black-and-white graphite pencil drawing suitable for children to colour. Use crisp, clearly defined subject contours, selective deep black accents and a full but restrained tonal range. Keep large clothing and object surfaces light and open for colouring. Use natural short pencil strokes and smooth, subtle shading; avoid long parallel stripes, mechanical hatching, blurred outlines and uniform grey fills. Preserve recognisable identity and fine details of the main subject.
tasks.prompt_basis: Corrected from the completed user baseline review; task-specific overrides retained.
